gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Impact Label hits hard with heavy, bead-like letters, while the serif body brings a refined, authoritative hand.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-pridi: Pridi is a classic serif whose small letters stand proud, with generous gaps where curves meet stems, under Impact Label's heavy, commanding shout. Body text here can stay modest.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-slabo-13px: Impact Label stamps out heavy, commanding letters, each one standing alone like a bead on a rod. Slabo 13px follows with bookish, dignified openness, large counters in a classic serif that keep the whole pairing approachable.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-suwannaphum: Impact Label brings a heavy, high-set weight, its c pincers pointing apart like open jaws. Suwannaphum follows, a dignified text serif with a tall, squared-off lowercase that earns its place once the heading has made its short, big statement.
gen-dafont-impact-label-inter: Impact Label is commanding and heavy, each letter set apart like a bead on a rod, with a high x-height guide. Inter then runs smooth as a tube, its strokes never swelling or thinning, and its big counters let the lines breathe.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-bitter: Dependable and grounded, with a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in every s. Bitter, a slab-serif, lets a long page move steadily while Jelly Crazies wobbles playfully above it.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-bespoke-sans: Sharp and refined, the sans body gives each curve generous room before it meets the stem. Bespoke Sans would carry a long passage crisply, a clear step away from the wobbly, nearly sealed bowls of Jelly Crazies.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-epunda-slab: Jelly Crazies draws its wobbly letters with a steady, drafting-pen line. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a visibly gaping c, gives the opposite of those closed shapes, and it reads best at a generous size.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, with big counters and curved letters that leave their mouths wide, unclosed. And Jelly Crazies, cut like stencils of one steady width, slows a longer passage to a leisurely walk.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hanuman: Playful wobble meets a traditional, refined hand here. Hanuman, a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, opens up exactly where Jelly Crazies closes its bowls shut.
